item.text: The local sandbox cannot start read-only commands, so I’m using the supplied evidence. The revision will move healing away from the eastern battery and give roadblock clearance explicit handoffs; the verified opening kill alone did not support either civilian’s safe arrival.

The candidate now keeps the opening outer duel ranges separate from the roadblocks, uses Kroos for upper eastern clearance, and brings Midnight in earlier for lower eastern clearance. It stages western clearance around the artillery fight, with both medics covering their own lanes from column 3. Artillery destruction before its western return remains a required, unverified deadline.
